Research Task

Task Description
Applied recommender-systems research: launch decisions weigh offline ranking quality against short online experiments.

Recommend whether to launch **RecSys-v2** vs production **RecSys-v1** using `offline_evaluation_metrics.csv` (held-out test **n = 200,000**; `recsys_v1` / `recsys_v2`, `relative_change_pct`) and `online_ab_test_metrics.csv` (**14-day**, **10%** traffic per arm; `recsys_*_pct` in **percentage points**). Deliver `model_evaluation_report.md` (tables, interpretation, recommendation).

Available Data Files
offline_evaluation_metrics.csv [feature_data] (data/offline_evaluation_metrics.csv): Offline test-set metrics for v1 vs v2.
online_ab_test_metrics.csv [feature_data] (data/online_ab_test_metrics.csv): Two-week online A/B metrics for v1 vs v2.

data.name: offline_evaluation_metrics
data.description: Offline metrics on test set n=200,000 — Precision@10, NDCG@10, Recall@50, catalog coverage.

data.name: online_ab_test_metrics
data.description: 14-day online A/B (10% traffic each) — CTR, D1/D7 retention, user complaint rate.
